title: Instant Improv, Role-First & Situation-First Generation
objective: Add fast role-first and situation-first NPC/creature proposal generation over the stable MNCS candidate and identity/origin layers without bypassing explicit constraints, unresolved-safe behavior or owner-domain authority.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded instant-improv, role-first and situation-first candidate generation plus quick-generation preset adapters while preserving MNCS-01 identity/constraint semantics and MNCS-04 identity/origin boundaries.
scope.completion_gate: A GM can request a fast role- or situation-first NPC/creature candidate and receive a stable, constraint-aware proposal without invented owner truth, lost locks/accepted fields, or paid-provider dependence.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.2.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-04 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-04-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-05 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
MNCS-01 remains stable candidate/recipe/constraint/lock/selective-regeneration authority and MNCS-04 remains identity/origin proposal-construction authority.
Fast generation must not treat speed as permission to invent unresolved canonical facts or bypass owner-domain references and acceptance states.
Role-first and situation-first prompts are proposal constraints, not canonical Character/NPC/Creature/World/Scene/Encounter truth.
Quick-generation presets are MNCS domain adapters over generic PCA substrate rather than a second generic generation framework.
MNCS-05 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MNCS-05 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MNCS-05 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MNCS-04 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MNCS-05 execution is active.
